title: Emoji and Reactions
drDigitalIntro:
Emoji are small pictures that express feelings — smiles, hearts, thumbs-up, and hundreds more.

- You can type emoji directly in a message using the smiley button next to the text box.
- You can also react to a message someone sent you by double-clicking (or pressing and holding) their message bubble — a row of reaction emoji pops up.
- Reactions say 'I saw this' or 'I feel this' without typing a whole reply.
- Both ways are handy: typed emoji go in your message, reactions go on theirs.

playgroundTask.goal: You sent an emoji and reacted to a message

steps.say: Click on Sam to open their conversation.
Click the smiley face button to open the emoji picker.
Double-click (or press and hold) Sam's message to react with an emoji.

drDigitalSuccess: You used two kinds of emoji — one in your message and one as a reaction. Both are great for quick, expressive replies.
drDigitalHint: Click Sam, then click the smiley button at the left of the message bar to open the emoji picker. After that, double-click Sam's message to add a reaction.
